method: Read official deployment documentation and selected files at an observed GitHub main commit; compare with ZenRouter's PostgreSQL ledger, Rust/Python runtime and enterprise-controlled file retention. No installation or runtime verification.

repository.name: QuantumNous/new-api
repository.qualification: Snapshot of main, not a certified deployed release.

sources.use: Deployment modes offered in official docs.
Single application container can connect to external PostgreSQL; local SQLite path is distinct.
Application and stateful dependencies composed together.
Multi-host examples and shared database/secrets; do not import its primary/replica application semantics.
Separate frontend/backend dev workflow; minimum versions not adopted.
Process supervision and init boundaries; ZenRouter drain sequence is our design.
Running dependencies are not necessarily ready; healthy/completion conditions.
Environment override and single-server deployment; Compose alone not a multi-host HA solution.
Per-platform artifacts and manifest lists; separate tests required.
Access mode requirements; RWX alone is not application mutual exclusion or a durability/HA guarantee.
Existing architecture evidence for draining; ordinary containers have no guaranteed stop order.

engineering_decisions: Use a common release and configurable runtime roles across delivery modes.
Compose default install; Docker single application container requires external PostgreSQL; no zero-dependency SQLite/all-in-one database promise.
Include Rust runtime, static UI and pinned Python adapter; supervise and drain multiple processes.
Multi-host body retention requires approved shared persistent storage with per-writer segments and recoverable indexing.
Cluster packaging includes multi-host Docker and Kubernetes/Helm targets; stages are proposed, not implemented.
not_performed: Performance, failure injection or recovery validation
local_validation_scope: Documentation rendering, local links/anchors, SVG and browser layout only.
